papers.title: Active Control of Topological Exceptional Points in Non-Hermitian Metasurfaces
papers.abstract: Active control and ultrafast switching of non-Hermitian photonic systems are essential for next-generation reconfigurable optical technologies. Here, we demonstrate dynamic temporal manipulation of EPs in the terahertz (THz) regime using optically excited germanium (Ge) as an active medium. By exploiting pump-probe delay as a continuous tuning parameter, we achieve sub-picosecond eigenmode switching (~0.5 ps) and realize a complete time-resolved EP encirclement within ~2 ps, enabling direct observation of topological phase accumulation. At EP, the metasurface exhibits highly asymmetric transmission for circularly polarized light, characteristic of chiral mode response. Furthermore, we observe ultrafast eigenmode switching and topological phase evolution within ~1 ps, achieving >99% cross-polarization modulation depth. The measured results show strong agreement with theoretical modeling, with a high Petermann factor of approximately 10^3, confirming the effectiveness of the design. Our work establishes pump-probe delay time as a dynamical control parameter for EP topology, introducing a new regime of ultrafast non-Hermitian photonics for high-speed switching, enhanced sensitivity, and tunable polarization control in the THz domain.

analysis.summary: 在THz频段利用光学泵浦Ge有源介质实现非厄米超表面EP的主动控制，完成亚皮秒本征模切换和~2ps EP环绕观测，实现>99%交叉偏振调制深度。
analysis.research思路: 解决非厄米光子系统缺乏主动实时控制手段的问题，通过泵浦-探针延迟作为连续调谐参数，在THz频段实现EP动态操控和拓扑相积累的直接观测。
analysis.experiment: 采用光学泵浦的Ge作为有源介质设计非厄米超表面，结合时间分辨泵浦-探针技术，以延迟时间为连续参数进行EP追踪，测量圆偏振光传输特性和本征模切换动力学。
analysis.innovation: 首次实现~0.5 ps亚皮秒本征模切换；~2 ps内完成完整时间分辨EP环绕；获得>99%交叉偏振调制深度；验证高Petermann因子(~10^3)的非厄米效应。
analysis.related_work: 包括非厄米光学和PT对称破缺理论、EP物理与拓扑性质研究、超表面/超材料设计、THz光子技术、以及基于Si、Ge等半导体有源介质的光控研究。
analysis.impact: 为可重构非厄米光子器件提供新范式，将EP工程从静态推向动态实时控制，对下一代高速光通信、传感和计算技术具有重要应用潜力。

domain_trend.trend: 超快光学正迈向'主动控制时代'——非厄米拓扑调控实现亚皮秒动态切换、可编程多波长激光器融合光子计算、超分辨探测突破阿秒极限，三者共塑实时可重构超快系统新范式。

papers.title: Engineering Multi-wavelength Emission in All-Fiber Laser Mode-Locked Through Nonlinear Polarization Rotation
papers.abstract: The increasing demand for multi-wavelength optical sources to support dense wavelength-division multiplexing (DWDM) channels has driven the development of compact and reconfigurable multi-wavelength fiber lasers. Here, we demonstrate a continuously tunable and deterministically switchable multi-wavelength erbium-doped fiber laser based on nonlinear polarization rotation (NPR) in a compact all-fiber ring cavity. By controlling the intracavity birefringence, NPR acts as a reconfigurable comb filter that enables flexible wavelength selection without modifying the cavity architecture. The laser supports stable spectral states ranging from single- to seven-wavelength mode-locking, enabling reversible wavelength switching and activation/suppression of individual channels. The selectable spectral states can be mapped to binary bit operations, where each wavelength channel represents a controllable logical state. The behavior arises from the interplay between NPR-induced birefringent comb filtering and nonlinear phase modulation, providing a simple and compact platform for reconfigurable multi-channel ultrafast sources for DWDM and photonic signal processing.

analysis.summary: 首次实现基于NPR的可编程1-7波长切换全光纤锁模激光器，创新性地将多波长状态映射为二进制逻辑操作。
analysis.research思路: 针对DWDM系统对紧凑可重构多波长光源的需求，探索利用NPR双折射效应构建可重构梳状滤波器实现灵活波长选择的技术路径。
analysis.experiment: 采用紧凑全光纤环形腔结构，通过精准控制腔内双折射元件(N/4波片+偏振控制器)调节NPR效应，构建可重构梳状滤波器实现多波长选择。
analysis.innovation: 突破传统多波长激光器波长固定或需重构腔体的限制，首次实现通过纯偏振态控制实现1-7波长连续可调、可逆切换及单独通道独立控制。
analysis.related_work: NPR锁模技术( Hofer 1992)、多波长掺铒光纤激光器( Bellemare 2000)、梳状滤波器技术( Girault 2019)及可调谐光纤激光器( Mokhtar 2003)。
analysis.impact: 为DWDM系统提供紧凑可重构光源解决方案，开创性地将物理层多波长状态与数字逻辑映射，为光子计算和智能光网络提供新范式。

analysis.summary: 利用兆电子伏特超快电子衍射结合超分辨率实空间反演算法，实现亚埃级分辨率可视化锥形交叉点处电子和核的超快动力学过程。
analysis.research思路: 解决锥形交叉点处快速非绝热分子动力学过程难以同时追踪电子与核运动的问题，为理解光化学反应中电子态演化提供直接实验依据。
analysis.experiment: 采用兆电子伏特超快电子衍射技术获得高时间分辨率，结合新开发的超分辨率实空间反演算法重构分子结构演化的三维动态图像。
analysis.innovation: 首次在亚埃级空间分辨率和飞秒级时间分辨率下直接观测锥形交叉点处的核与电子耦合运动，突破传统衍射技术分辨率极限。
analysis.related_work: 超快电子衍射技术发展、锥形交叉理论及实验研究、分子动力学非绝热过程的超快光谱探测等领域的相关工作。
analysis.impact: 为光化学反应、 photosynthesis等涉及锥形交叉的分子动力学过程提供新的实验观测手段，推动超快化学和量子动力学领域的发展。
